d: Mokama men Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi Singh ki shadi men mehmanon ki bhari bhir juti thi. isi bich shadi samaroh men ek kathit chor mobail chori karte hue pakra gaya. mobail churane ki koshish ke dauran logon ne use pakar liya. Anant Singh ke ghar aayojit is bhavy shadi samaroh men VVIP mehmanon se lekar bari sankhya men aam log bhi pahunche the. shadi ki khushiyon ke bich mobail chori ki is ghatna ne sabka dhyan khinch liya.
